damage_story: A blast strikes the east pump lane, drops the southeast canopy bay and tears open the shop utility corner while leaving the storefront, checkout, stockroom, manager office and receiving route legible.
damage_zone: east forecourt and southeast utility corner
environment_layer: tapered masonry and gravel rubble beneath the failed shop corner
fallen canopy member across the east pump lane
scrap and refuse concentrated near the blast side
weathered highway apron, parking and service surfaces
occupation_layer: roadside loot retained in the surviving stockroom
pillagers occupying the protected manager-office area
invariants: highway apron, road sign and most pump lanes survive
the reinforced underground fuel-tank vault survives beneath the forecourt
front entrance and checkout remain readable
multiple sales-floor cross aisles remain navigable
stockroom, manager office and rear receiving exit remain accessible
damage remains localized to a causally related blast zone
